dedupe_keys.name: sections de comptage du trafic routier

description: Sections de comptage du trafic routier is a dataset listed in Open data - Département d'Eure-et-Loir, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CD28. Sections de comptage du nombre de véhicules en moyenne journalière annuelle, tous véhicules et pourcentage poids-lourds. Les sections de comptage représentent un linéaire compté de plus de 3400 km sur les 7500 km du réseau routier départemental. Les cartes PDF des trafics routiers sont disponibles ci-dessous dans la section "Pièces jointes". Coverage: Eure-et-Loir. The portal files it under Routes. The portal shows 870 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-eurelien-fr-portal.
